args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks across all production regions with an elevated error rate (~18%), impacting checkout availability. Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified successful — v2.3.0 is healthy across all regions with an error rate back down to ~0.2%. Next steps: investigate the v2.3.1 regression (changes not yet identified) before re-attempting release; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is found and fixed.
args.title: checkout-api failed health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Identified rollback target**: Checked the release history — v2.3.0 was the most recent version that was healthy in production (the prior healthy release was v2.2.9).
3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Verified the service is healthy again with the error rate back down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Filed SEV2 incident **INC-0001** with the full details of the failure, the rollback, and the recommendation to investigate the v2.3.1 regression before attempting to redeploy. The on-call engineer has been paged.
